subject.title: fix: avoid false stayed-stopped on launchd KeepAlive throttle

question: Should the current-main one-second launchd throttle remain the sole fix for this bug, or is an additional supervisor-aware restart-health threshold still required?
rationale: Both approaches can prevent the reported release failure, but keeping both creates duplicate timing policy and changes genuine-failure latency; repository history available in this review does not establish that maintainers intend both layers.

options.title: Keep the current-main owner fix
options.body: Close or replace this branch because the canonical LaunchAgent generator and restart rewrite now remove the ten-second race at its source.

options.title: Retain both protections
options.body: Rebase and prove a current-main case where the one-second generated throttle still false-fires before keeping a supplemental health threshold.

recommendation.title: Keep the current-main owner fix
recommendation.body: Close or replace this branch because the canonical LaunchAgent generator and restart rewrite now remove the ten-second race at its source.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the canonical boundary between current launchd lifecycle ownership and generic CLI restart-health behavior.
